Identity of two transition simplex rows and positive ordered emission rates phi/lambda. Both likelihoods sum all hidden paths by the same log-space forward recursion, with initial state weights one rather than a normalized uniform distribution. Each emission is the sum of Exponential(u;phi) and Exponential(v;lambda) log densities.

Shared-support limitation: original Stan points enforce all ordered or positive-ordered constraints. PyMC ordering supplied only by a transform is not separately enforced after transforms are removed. These evaluations compare points on the shared Stan-valid support, not global support or model equivalence.
